tax.text: Nehls says he supports lower taxes as part of his economic agenda.
tax.quote: Trever supports lower taxes, fewer regulations and a pro-growth agenda that strengthens the American economy.

safety.text: Nehls says he would fully fund and support law enforcement and opposes policies he describes as soft on crime.
safety.quote: He opposes soft-on-crime leftist policies and will fully fund and support law enforcement.

immigration.text: Nehls says he would support completing the border wall, ending catch-and-release, and deporting undocumented immigrants who violate the law.
immigration.quote: Congress must help President Trump fully secure the southern border, finish the wall, end catch-and-release permanently, and deport illegal aliens who violate our laws.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He says he would block gender ideology in schools and protect girls’ sports.
gender.quote: He will vote to eliminate DEI mandates, block gender ideology in schools, protect girls’ sports, and require full curriculum transparency.

energy.text: Nehls supports expanding domestic oil, gas, and nuclear production and reducing regulations he says raise gas prices.
energy.quote: He will fight to end any remaining Biden anti-energy policies while focusing on legislation that expands domestic production and cuts burdensome regulations that drive up gas prices for families.

tax.text: She said she would support a middle-class tax break and a larger child tax credit.
tax.quote: I would vote for a middle-class tax break. Also we need to bring down inflation. The child tax credit could be increased as well.

wages.text: She said Congress should raise the federal minimum wage and index it to inflation.
wages.quote: Congress must raise the federal minimum wage. We need to expand tax credits for working families and lower the costs for housing, healthcare, and essentials.

schools.text: She opposed vouchers and said school choice takes money away from public schools.
schools.quote: I do not believe in school choice. I believe it takes money away from public schools.

immigration.text: She supports increased border staffing while also supporting legal immigration procedures and a path to citizenship.
immigration.quote: There should be effective procedures in place to allow people to legally immigrate to the U.S. and there should be a path to citizenship.

guns.text: She called for a waiting period and restrictions on automatic rifles.
guns.quote: There should be common sense gun regulations. There should be a waiting period to own a gun. There is no need for a citizen to own an automatic rifle.

abortion.text: She supports abortion in cases including risk to the pregnant person's life, rape or incest, and before viability.
abortion.quote: I believe if the life of the mother is at risk, an abortion should be allowed. I believe in cases of rape and incest; an abortion should be allowed.

health.text: She said Congress should pass universal healthcare and that coverage should not depend on employment or income.
health.quote: We must pass universal healthcare. Having health insurance should not be tied to employment or economic status. It is the right of every American to have healthcare.

energy.text: She endorsed a strong federal climate action plan and said inaction was not an option.
energy.quote: Yes. Climate action is an economic and public safety plan. Climate change is currently driving higher energy bills and extreme weather. Doing nothing is not an option.
